records.name: La Rioja
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score.

records.name: País Vasco/Euskadi
records.summary: No region-specific law or incident series diverges from the national framework, but the country dossier records a mixed finding for this community: with Navarra it tops the state hate-crime statistics (highest per-capita LGTBI-motivated offence rates in the 2024 Interior report) — a result the dossier attributes to intensive reporting and counting, not to danger: the regional government runs its own LGTBI public-order police and an equality observatory maintaining a comparative legislation database, and no Basque statute rollback exists. Net visitor risk is assessed at approximately the national score, with the high recorded counts read as neutral-to-positive.

records.name: Comunidad Foral de Navarra
records.summary: No region-specific law or incident series diverges from the national framework, but the country dossier records a mixed finding for this community: it is the single highest per-capita LGTBI hate-offence region in the 2024 Interior report — a result the dossier reads as a reporting-institution effect, since Pamplona runs an annual anti-LGTBIphobia observatory whose 2025 report documents rising discourse, and the region polices public order with its own force. Net visitor risk is assessed at approximately the national score, with the high recorded counts read as reporting quality rather than a safety deficit.
